how-it-works.intro: Page Notes: sticky notes on any website. Here's how it works, in two minutes.
pre: First, add Page Notes to Chrome from the Chrome Web Store. Then pin its orange icon next to the address bar, so it's always one click away.
chapters: Watching a video? Click the Page Notes icon, hit New note, then click where you want the note, and type.
Found something for later? Drag a note straight off the toolbar, and drop it right next to it.
To highlight text, press Alt, Shift, L, or choose Text. Select a sentence: it's highlighted, and your note sits right next to it.
Press Alt, Shift, E to stick a note to an element. It follows that card when the layout changes.
Come back later, and every note is right where you left it. Use the arrows on the toolbar to step through them.
The extension bar shows your notes on this page, this site, and everywhere, with quick filters.
All notes lists every note from every site. Search, and jump straight back to it.
And settings let you make it yours.
post: Your notes never leave your browser. No account, no server, no tracking. And it's open source.
how-it-works.outro: That's Page Notes. It's free. Add it to Chrome from the link below, and check out the other videos in this playlist.

extension-bar.intro: Page Notes, part two: the extension bar. Everything is one click away.
chapters: Click the Page Notes icon next to the address bar. The badge shows how many notes are on this page.
Up top: notes on this page, this site, and everywhere.
The sites menu lists every site you've noted, with counts. Pick one to see its notes.
Switch between this page, this site, and your recent notes.
Quick filters show only urgent, open, or done notes.
Mark a note done right from the list.
Click a card to jump to that note.
Need a new note? Click New note, then click on the page and type.
This switch hides the notes on this page only. Nothing is deleted.
Tips and colors shows the shortcuts. And the extension bar speaks ten languages.
The gear opens settings, and All notes opens the full list.
extension-bar.outro: That's the extension bar. Next up: the on-page toolbar. Page Notes is free, link below.

toolbar.intro: Page Notes, part three: the toolbar on the page.
chapters: Pages with notes get a small toolbar: the note count, arrows, the New note button, and a few handy buttons.
Click plus Note, then click anywhere on the page. A short guide shows the tricks while you place it.
The arrow next to Note lets you choose a free note, a note stuck to an element, or a text highlight.
Choose Text, then select a few words. They're highlighted, with your note right next to them.
While placing, press N for a note, E for an element, or T for text. Escape cancels.
Or just grab plus Note, and drop it exactly where you want.
Use the arrows to jump from note to note.
The eye hides this page's notes. Click again to bring them back.
Options: all your notes, copy this page's notes as text, delete all, settings, and quick switches.
Drag the toolbar by its logo. It snaps to the nearest side.
Click the logo to minimize it. And the X closes it until your next note.
toolbar.outro: That's the toolbar. Next: every option on a note. Page Notes is free, link below.

note-options.intro: Page Notes, part four: every option on a note.
chapters: Reviewing a site? Click plus Note, click the spot, and type. Links turn into little chips.
Pick one of four colors.
Mark it urgent.
Mark it done, or reopen it.
Copy a link to this exact note.
Fold it into a small tab, and unfold it again.
Drag the top bar to move it, and drag the corner to resize it.
Delete it. Changed your mind? Click Undo.
Come back tomorrow, and it's still there.
note-options.outro: That's every note option. Next: the All notes page. Page Notes is free, link below.

all-notes.intro: Page Notes, part five: all your notes in one place.
chapters: All notes shows every note from every site, with a snapshot of where it sits.
Search notes, page titles, and links.
Filter by open, done, urgent, highlights, or links. The counts update as you go. Or filter by color.
Narrow it to one site, and change the sort.
Every card has an open and done switch.
Edit opens the note as a sticky note. Change the text or the color, then save.
Click Select, tick a few cards, then mark them done, urgent, or share them all at once.
And the arrow takes you right back to the note on its page.
all-notes.outro: That's All notes. Last one: settings. Page Notes is free, link below.

settings.intro: Page Notes, part six: settings. Make it yours.
chapters: Settings live right next to All notes.
Turn every note off at once, or show notes only when you open Page Notes.
Choose the toolbar style: when needed, always small, or hidden.
Tips while you place notes, the guide style, and the undo bar.
Pick one of ten languages, and keep snapshots for your list.
See your keyboard shortcuts, and change them in Chrome.
Your data stays on this device. Export a backup, import it elsewhere, or clear it.
settings.outro: That's settings, and the whole tour. Page Notes is free and open source. Add it to Chrome from the link below.
